title: Meter Reading Inspection Checklist Form
subtitle: An original meter reading workflow that guides a bounded inspection from readiness through findings and release, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete meter reading inspection checklist form for the utility meter and register that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when an assigned inspector must confirm safe observation boundaries, document domain-specific conditions, route deficiencies, and record a qualified acceptance, restriction, or follow-up decision. The meter operations lead owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: Meter reading inspection identity and authority
sections.guidance: Define the asset, inspection scope, qualified reviewer, and conditions before observations begin.

sections.title: Meter reading readiness and safe observation boundary
sections.guidance: Confirm identity, operating context, access, and limits before checking condition.

blocks.label: Stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: A reading record does not authorize opening, bypassing, adjusting, or repairing a meter or related service equipment. Stop for gas odor, exposed electrical parts, water near energized equipment, flooding, animals, traffic, or unsafe access. Withdraw, keep others clear, and route the condition to qualified utility or emergency personnel under current site procedures.

sections.title: Meter reading inspection points and finding evidence
sections.guidance: Check each point only when observed; use the findings table for condition, evidence, and disposition.

blocks.label: Domain inspection checklist
items: Account, premise, meter, register, commodity, and location agree
Route instructions, access authorization, and appointment details were checked
Traffic, animals, weather, vegetation, ice, flooding, and trip hazards were assessed
Meter enclosure, cover, support, seal, and visible connections are intact
Display, register, unit, multiplier, decimal position, and flow direction are legible
Reading was captured without opening, bypassing, adjusting, or disturbing equipment
Photograph or remote evidence clearly shows identity and displayed value
Read date, time, method, source, and operator are traceable
Prior read and expected pattern were compared for obvious variance
Tamper, reverse flow, leak, heat, odor, damage, or communication fault was escalated
Estimated or unobtainable read includes a reason and next-attempt owner
Accepted, corrected, held, or investigated disposition is explicit

fields.label: Inaccessible areas, sampling limits, representative conditions, trends, and supporting context

sections.title: Meter reading exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Gas odor, hissing, damaged regulator, or suspected leak
Exposed conductor, arcing, heat, burn mark, or damaged electric enclosure
Flooding, standing water, active leak, ice, or unstable walking surface
Aggressive animal, insect nest, traffic, excavation, or restricted access
Broken seal or enclosure requiring opening or equipment manipulation
Unknown meter identity, cross-connection, or unsafe customer equipment
Weather or site condition prevents a safe, reliable observation
Any work beyond a normal-interface read and assigned authorization
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: A reading record does not authorize opening, bypassing, adjusting, or repairing a meter or related service equipment. Stop for gas odor, exposed electrical parts, water near energized equipment, flooding, animals, traffic, or unsafe access. Withdraw, keep others clear, and route the condition to qualified utility or emergency personnel under current site procedures.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each inspection exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: Meter reading decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Utility meter and register identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
